title: CommandHelpMap entry required -- ref
desc: T3 reference for commandhelpmap-entry-required-for-every-dispatched-command: dated audits, verified evidence scripts, alias registration edge cases, and the source_refs relocation history
steps: ALIAS RULE: top-level aliases such as close, kill, and window must also have CommandHelpMap entries when they are user-facing dispatch targets, even if they mirror a11y or taskkill help text.

EXEC ALIAS PATTERN (2026-05-26): if a CommandHelpMap entry describes an alias (e.g. --exec is an alias for exec), the alias MUST also be registered as a dispatch entry in Program.Dispatch.cs with an or --exec clause, AND the CMD execution guard will require the alias to actually succeed in evidence scripts.
VERIFIED evidence scripts: ev-exec-cmdhelp.sh (2026-05-25), ev-exec-commandhelp-entry.sh (2026-05-25), ev-schedule-commandhelp.sh (2026-06-02), ev-commandhelpmap-present-2026-06-06.sh (2026-06-06).
AUDIT 2026-06-03: source_refs became stale, pattern CommandHelpMap no longer matched at the recorded line.

AUDIT 2026-06-06: PATTERN-NOT-FOUND -- 'CommandHelpMap = new' moved from CommandHelp.cs line 235 to a partial file (CommandHelp.Map.cs or Entries.*.cs) after a partial-class refactor; always grep for the current location rather than trusting a stale line number.

TANGENTIAL 2026-05-20 (unrelated to CommandHelpMap itself, filed under the same skill): wkask.ps1 wrong-tab response capture -- a domain-only grap like domain=chatgpt.com picks the wrong ChatGPT tab when multiple tabs exist; fix is to parse hwnd from cdp open output and use an hwnd-scoped grap for response reads.

LIVE CASE 2026-07-02: a cluster of 10 urgent BUG-AUTO suggests (TypeInitializationException/FileNotFoundException/FileLoadException, all in Program.A11yCommandImpl dispatch, ts 2026-06-11T02:04-02:06) turned out to be ONE repeated root cause: commit 7e6f93df4 extracted HTS commands (hts-stress/prompt-test/prompt-probe) to a plugin but left dead dispatch arms in Program.Dispatch.cs referencing now-nonexistent methods, causing a <Module> static-initializer failure on every a11y dispatch. Already fixed ~15h later by commit f4cfdcaf6 (removed dead arms, added PluginLoader.IsPluginCommand() fallthrough). LESSON: after any command-to-plugin extraction, grep Program.Dispatch.cs for the extracted command's dispatch arm BEFORE merging -- a dangling arm crashes the WHOLE dispatch table (Module init failure), not just that one command.
author: claude
